entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: Information element that informs the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that are pending due to incomplete network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information representing a network slice.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Procedure for authenticating and authorizing network slice usage.

entities.name: Pending due to incomplete authentication
entities.description: Condition where S-NSSAIs are pending because network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure is not completed.

relations.description: Pending NSSAI IE contains one or more S-NSSAIs.
S-NSSAIs are pending due to incomplete network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure.
Incomplete network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure establishes the pending condition for S-NSSAIs.
